# Google Ads MCP (unofficial)
Unofficial Model Context Protocol server for the Google Ads REST API.
Repository: https://github.com/davidmosiah/google-ads-mcp-unofficial
NPM: https://www.npmjs.com/package/google-ads-mcp-unofficial
Primary command: npm exec --yes --package=google-ads-mcp-unofficial -- google-ads-mcp-server doctor
MCP command: google-ads-mcp-server

- MCP registry name: io.github.davidmosiah/google-ads-mcp
- Start agents with google_ads_connection_status and google_ads_data_inventory before any data tool.
- Default tools are READ-ONLY: discovery, list, performance, daily report, find waste.
- WRITE tools (pause/resume/bid/budget) are DISABLED by default and gated behind GOOGLE_ADS_ALLOW_MUTATIONS.
- Required env: GOOGLE_ADS_DEVELOPER_TOKEN, GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_ADS_CLIENT_SECRET.
- Optional env: GOOGLE_ADS_LOGIN_CUSTOMER_ID (MCC), GOOGLE_ADS_REDIRECT_URI, GOOGLE_ADS_PRIVACY_MODE (summary|structured|raw), GOOGLE_ADS_NO_RETRY, GOOGLE_ADS_CACHE.
- Customer ids are partial-redacted (123-***-7890) by default. Set privacy_mode=raw to see full ids.
- Tokens stay local under ~/.google-ads-mcp/tokens.json (0600 perms) and are never returned by tools.
- Mutations are logged to stderr for audit. Always review proposed changes before enabling write tools.
- Not affiliated with Google. Use at your own risk — agents changing real ad spend is high-stakes.
